user_stories.title: Implement CausalDAIN for prefix-only normalization
user_stories.description: Replace current DAIN with a strictly causal variant that computes normalization statistics (mean/std) only from timesteps 0..t (inclusive) for each timestep t, ensuring no future information leaks. Must integrate with existing normalization interface.
acceptance_criteria: CausalDAIN class implements same interface as existing DAIN
Normalization at timestep t uses only prefix x[:, :t+1] for statistics
Forward pass produces same output shape as original DAIN
Gradient flow remains correct for training
user_stories.verification: Unit test: generate random sequence, compute CausalDAIN output, manually verify each timestep's statistics match prefix-only calculation.

user_stories.title: Enforce causal masks in all attention/T-KAN layers
user_stories.description: Audit all attention and T-KAN layers in CausalLOBForecaster (and any subcomponents) to ensure strict causal masking: each timestep t can only attend to timesteps <= t. Replace any full-context attention with causal variants.
acceptance_criteria: All attention layers use torch.tril causal masks
T-KAN temporal convolutions use causal padding (pad left only)
No global pooling operations that aggregate future information
Siamese feature extractor processes each timestep independently
user_stories.verification: Component test: for each layer, corrupt future inputs and verify early outputs unchanged (max diff < 1e-6).

user_stories.title: Integrate causal components into CausalLOBForecaster
user_stories.description: Replace existing DAIN and any non-causal layers in ML-005 CausalLOBForecaster with the causal versions from CAUSAL-001 and CAUSAL-002. Update model initialization and forward pass accordingly.
acceptance_criteria: CausalLOBForecaster uses CausalDAIN instead of DAIN
All submodules (attention, T-KAN, fusion) are causal
Model maintains same input/output interface
Training mode still works with causal constraints
user_stories.verification: Run full model forward pass with fixed seeds, compare outputs before/after future corruption (early 10 timesteps must match within 1e-5).

user_stories.title: Add rigorous causality verification test
user_stories.description: Create pytest test that constructs CausalLOBForecaster in eval mode with fixed seeds, runs 'corrupt future timesteps' test, and checks early outputs remain unchanged within explicit tolerance (atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-3).
acceptance_criteria: Test sets torch manual seed and model.eval()
Test corrupts inputs after timestep 10 by adding noise
Checks torch.allclose(out1[:, :10, :], out2[:, :10, :], atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-3)
Test passes only if causality holds
user_stories.verification: Run pytest src/models/test_causality.py -v and see test pass.

user_stories.title: Regenerate models and run full council verification
user_stories.description: After implementing causal fixes, regenerate ML-005 (CausalLOBForecaster) and ML-007 (T_KAN) code, then run council verification to ensure causality test passes and existing functionality remains intact.
acceptance_criteria: Council run completes without crashes (exit_code=0)
Causality verification test passes
Other existing tests (e.g., training step) still pass
Model performance metrics remain within acceptable bounds
user_stories.verification: Run full council script and check exit code 0 with all tests passing.
